question: What share of a lead-acid cell's mass is lead or lead oxide, what share of a Li-ion cell's weight is active cathode material, and how many times larger is the first?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE (page=3 AND (text ILIKE '%70%' OR text ILIKE '%30%' OR text ILIKE '%lead oxide%' OR text ILIKE '%cathode material%')) OR (page=6 AND text ILIKE '%10 times%')
SELECT (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text,'(\d+)%',1) AS DOUBLE) FROM lines WHERE id='p3.L22') / (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text,'(\d+)%',1) AS DOUBLE) FROM lines WHERE id='p3.L49') AS ratio
